# Royal Simpson Pinto (royalpinto007)

> AI product engineer, indie developer and freelancer. Builds AI agents, LLM tooling, full-stack apps, backend systems, automation, Web3 tools and open source. 3+ years shipping production software. Google Summer of Code, Linux Foundation (LFX) and Symmetry Autumn of Code contributor; mentored 500+ students. Studied at the National Institute of Technology Karnataka, Surathkal (NITK).

## Selected projects

- [AgentPostmortem](https://github.com/AgentPostmortem/agentpostmortem): open reliability benchmark and fault-injection runner for AI agents; 25 failure scenarios judged by real side effects. Python, MCP, on PyPI.
- [BoardEject](https://boardeject.dev): converts Apple Freeform boards to editable Excalidraw, or a verified local archive. Nothing is uploaded.
- [SignalizeAI](https://signalizeai.org): browser extension that researches a company once and alerts when its pricing, hiring or messaging changes.
- [AashiNyra](https://aashinyra.com): deal tracking with real price drops and UPI cashback.
